day_shape: 59 items dominated by Khamenei funeral coverage moving to Qom with Iraq/Mashhad legs to follow, IDF strike in Nabatieh al-Fawqa kills four, Israel-Lebanon framework signed in Washington, British Foremans continue Evin hunger strike; nothing from UK Parliament, State Dept or OFAC.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral procession moves to Qom
threads.summary: Regime channels ran continuous coverage of the transfer of Khamenei's body to Qom, with IRIB and Defa Press posting farewell imagery, provincial closures in Semnan and Mazandaran, and IRGC mobile-hospital deployment. Khamenei's office said funerals will proceed in Qom on 16 Tir, Iraq on 17 Tir with Najaf first per organiser Saad Maan, then Mashhad for burial.

threads.label: External coverage of Iran funeral
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Kataib Hezbollah representatives paraded on the third day and red revenge flags were waved, with Israel's security establishment monitoring the pilgrimage of foreign militant leaders to Tehran. Iran International reported backlash over the funeral's cost and attendance, and said Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei was reappointed judiciary chief for another five years.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon strike and Israel-Lebanon framework
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed a strike on a vehicle in Nabatieh al-Fawqa killing four, which Defa Press characterised as a ceasefire violation, while the IDF also said it recovered over 150 weapons in Hadatha over the past month. Times of Israel reported Ambassador Yechiel Leiter opened the fifth Washington round with both sides signing an Israel-Lebanon framework.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Hamas Emergency Committee
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas Training Department commander Fadi Falah Ashour Daghmash and, in a weekend strike west of the Yellow Line, killed Nukhba operative Hudhayfah Hussein al-Hawajri with four others. Hamas announced the head of its Emergency Committee had resigned as a first step to dissolving the body, with the Board of Peace saying assessment will be guided by actions.

threads.label: British detainees and Iran-linked espionage cases
threads.summary: Iran International and Jerusalem Post reported Britons Craig and Lindsay Foreman remain on hunger strike in Evin prison, citing HRANA that they have been denied medical care, medicine and family contact. Jerusalem Post also reported a Tajik national in Israel is being prosecuted for allegedly passing missile-impact site information to Iranian intelligence.

events.title_en: Deployment of the IRGC Ground Forces super-specialised mobile hospital in Qom to serve mourners / round-the-clock and free services
events.summary_en: Deployment of the IRGC Ground Forces super-specialised mobile hospital in Qom to serve mourners / round-the-clock and free services. Brigadier General Sayed Reza Mortazavian, head of Shahid Sadoughi Hospital in Isfahan affiliated with the IRGC Ground Forces, announced the deployment and commencement of operations of this force's super-specialised mobile hospital on Pasdaran Boulevard in the city of Qom. Given the significant presence of those accompanying the pure body of the great leader of the revolution, this 64-bed mobile hospital with a capacity of 85 specialised and support personnel has been deployed on site and is ready to provide medical services to ceremony participants. The hospital is equipped with two specialised operating theatres, laboratory, and radiological imaging facilities.

Significant efforts have been made by Popular Mobilisation Forces and Iraqi police. Iraqi army forces play a major role in this ceremony. 351 mourning tents have been registered in Najaf for the path of the martyred leader's funeral and household tents and Husayniyyahs are also active. In Karbala, more than 400 mourning tents have been set up.

events.title: The IDF confirms carrying out a strike in the Nabatieh al-Fawqa area in southern Lebanon this afternoon, saying it targeted suspects approaching Israel's buffer zone. The strike on a car in the area killed four people, according to Lebanese media. The military says it identified a car with four suspects in it approaching the south Lebanon security zone. The suspects had "posed a threat to IDF soldiers," and they were then targeted by the Israeli Air Force, the IDF says.

events.title: An airstrike in the northern Gaza Strip over the weekend targeted five Hamas operatives who were attempting to restore a tunnel system, the military says. The IDF says the tunnel was located on the western side of the Yellow Line, in Hamas-run territory. The strike on Saturday killed Hudhayfah Hussein Abdullah al-Hawajr, a Nukhba Force operative in Hamas' East Jabalia Battalion, the army says. The other four operatives were hit in the strike but their conditions are unknown.
